name: guided_hole_counterbore_past_the_edge
why: Z-C21.10, finding N50 (lot Z-C21.2), the second half. The radius that hole_wizard checked against distance_mm was the largest of the drilled diameters (ThruTapDrillDiameter, TapDrillDiameter, ThruHoleDiameter, HoleDiameter): CounterBoreDiameter was left out. A counterbored M8 anchored 6 mm from an edge passed (drilled hole Ø9, radius 4.5 < 6), and the counterbore went past the edge. Now the widest cut counts: the counterbore for «counterbore», the countersink for «countersink», each read only for its own type of hole (IWizardHoleFeatureData2~CounterBoreDiameter.html: «This property is relevant only for swCounterBored and swCounterBoredDrilled holes»).
defect_caught: Step 3 asks for a counterbored M8 whose centre is 6 mm from the left side: it must be refused because of the counterbore, and leave the part as it was. On library 0.140.0 it is RED: the check used the drilled radius 4.5, the hole was made, anchored and confirmed with the counterbore breaking through the side face. Step 2 is the twin: the same counterbored M8 at 20 from both edges fits, and must still be made and anchored; its «counterbore_mm» proves that SOLIDWORKS declares the counterbore the check reads.
_and_the_twin_is_in_the_same_file: Step 3 and step 2 are the same operation, same face, same type and size of hole, and differ only in the position and its anchor distance (6 instead of 20 from the side).
_the_numbers: Plate 200 x 120 x 20 = 480000. ISO 4762 M8: the head is Ø13 (dk max), so the counterbore that houses it is at least Ø13, radius at least 6.5 (the SOLIDWORKS table value is printed in «counterbore_mm» at step 2); the clearance hole is Ø9, radius 4.5. Step 3: centre at x = -94, 6 from the side at x = -100. Old check: 4.5 <= 6, accepted. New check: 6.5 or more > 6, refused; the counterbore would stand out of the side by at least 0.5 mm. Step 2: 20 from both edges, 20 > 7.5 whatever the table says between 13 and 15.

expect.why: present only when CounterBoreDiameter > 0: the counterbore the new check reads is declared
the anchor was applied: the fit check with the counterbore let a hole at 20 through

message_includes: less than the radius of the counterbore
